answer: The velvet index is deterministic from ledger replay, so that nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Flooding registration pushes someone to the back of the lagoon queue while genuine members promoted earlier keep earning. Admission is quota-limited: at most 955 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the pulse. A 477 account operation therefore ties up 39 million dollars of idle capital. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
